qa_gates.hold_point: No procurement, fabrication, or site work starts until design assumptions, interfaces, hazards, and inspection/test plans are baselined.
qa_gates.evidence: approved drawing register, interface control document, hazard-log snapshot, inspection/test plan, material and supplier register

qa_gates.asset: carbody, underframe, crash structure, coupler pockets
qa_gates.hold_point: Dimensional survey, weld traceability, NDT sample, corrosion-protection record, and crash/load evidence accepted before fit-out.
qa_gates.evidence: EN 15085 weld pack, welder qualifications, material certificates, dimensional report, NDT report, coating record

qa_gates.hold_point: Bogie frame, wheelset, bearing, brake, and suspension records accepted before bogie marriage.
qa_gates.evidence: bogie frame NDT, wheel profile and axle UT/MT, bearing certificate, brake static test, torque/fastener log

qa_gates.asset: traction motors, inverters, brake blending, onboard battery, thermal system
qa_gates.hold_point: Bench and trainset-level functional tests accepted before dynamic movement.
qa_gates.evidence: motor/inverter factory test, insulation resistance, BMS cell map, contactor test, thermal soak, brake-rate test

qa_gates.asset: doors, HVAC, lighting, interiors, accessibility, passenger information
qa_gates.hold_point: Passenger-facing systems pass functional, accessibility, fire-load, and maintainability checks before trial service.
qa_gates.evidence: door cycle log, HVAC performance test, saloon inspection, PRM checklist, emergency equipment inventory

qa_gates.asset: TCN-E, onboard ATP/ATO computers, odometry, radios, sensor suite
qa_gates.hold_point: Hardware identity, firmware versions, message authentication, degraded-mode response, and simulator replay pass before line testing.
qa_gates.evidence: hardware serial register, firmware hash register, cybersecurity checklist, simulator replay, trainline continuity test

qa_gates.hold_point: First trainset completes static, dynamic, endurance, braking, charging, evacuation, and maintainability acceptance before series release.
qa_gates.evidence: first-article inspection report, 1,000 km fault-free run, braking curves, charging logs, rescue/coupling drill, maintainability demonstration

qa_gates.hold_point: Survey control, cadastral constraints, buried utilities, flood paths, and geotechnical assumptions accepted before civil construction.
qa_gates.evidence: topographic survey, utility scan, borehole/test-pit log, flood/drainage map, ROW constraint register

qa_gates.hold_point: Compaction, capping layer, drainage, culverts, and fence lines accepted before trackform installation.
qa_gates.evidence: compaction test, material gradation, drainage as-built, culvert inspection, fence/gate punch list

qa_gates.asset: slab track, rail, fasteners, welds, turnouts, level crossings
qa_gates.hold_point: Track geometry, rail welds, fasteners, switch detection, and crossing protection accepted before energized testing.
qa_gates.evidence: track geometry run, weld NDT, fastener torque log, turnout detection test, crossing functional test

qa_gates.asset: viaducts, bridges, bearings, expansion joints, parapets, walkways
qa_gates.hold_point: Structural QA, bearing installation, drainage, access, and fall-protection checks accepted before track loading.
qa_gates.evidence: concrete/rebar records, bearing survey, load/test certificate where required, expansion-joint record, walkway inspection

qa_gates.asset: stations, depots, railway production plant, public realm
qa_gates.hold_point: Platforms, canopy PV, passenger circulation, depot pits, workshop tools, fire/life safety, and accessibility accepted before public opening.
qa_gates.evidence: platform gauge survey, canopy inspection, fire/life-safety signoff, accessibility audit, tool calibration, depot bay test

qa_gates.asset: PV, stationary storage, chargers, grid/PPA interconnection, earthing
qa_gates.hold_point: PV strings, storage, chargers, protection, earthing, islanding, and emergency isolation accepted before train charging.
qa_gates.evidence: PV string test, BESS commissioning record, charger load test, protection relay settings, earthing test, isolation drill

qa_gates.asset: wayside nodes, switches, intrusion sensors, comms, fare and passenger systems
qa_gates.hold_point: Wayside hardware, comms resilience, switch control, intrusion verdicts, passenger systems, and cybersecurity accepted before trial running.
qa_gates.evidence: W-SBC identity register, radio coverage, switch proof test, sensor calibration, CCTV/fare-system test, penetration-test closeout

qa_gates.hold_point: No passenger opening until integrated service, degraded modes, emergency response, maintenance handback, and safety evidence are accepted.
qa_gates.evidence: trial-running log, timetable reliability report, emergency exercise, possession/handback records, open-defect register, safety-case release note
qa_gates.release_authority: owner acceptance board + regulator/authority where applicable

maintenance_intervals.asset: platforms, public areas, ticketing, passenger information

canopy/fixing visual, platform drainage, ramps/tactiles, charger cabinet visual, fire extinguishers, signage

maintenance_intervals.scope: health dashboard, radio coverage alarms, time sync, message-authentication failures, CCTV/fare/PIS fault queue

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Manufacturing baseline, ITP, and traveller release
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Freeze asset register, route build lots, production traveller numbering, QA hold points, material release rules, and staff authorization matrix.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Publish baseline schedule; assign lot numbers; approve traveller templates; map QA gates to work packages; brief production supervisors.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: Approved design.toml, scenario.toml, QA template, maintenance template, manufacturing template
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: Baseline schedule, work breakdown structure, lot register, authorization matrix
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: signed schedule baseline, ITP register, revision-controlled traveller pack

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Trainset material kit and production traveller
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Create the trainset production traveller, allocate BOM kit, verify cell, motor, inverter, brake, door, HVAC, interior, and fastener traceability.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Pick kit; scan serials; quarantine substitutions; attach certificates; release first operation.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: Approved rolling-stock BOM, material certificates, software baseline
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: released kit, trainset traveller, serial traceability sheet

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Carbody, bogie, wheelset, and brake build
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Fabricate carbody modules, weld/bolt structural interfaces, assemble bogies, wheelsets, suspension, and electromagnetic brake assemblies.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Build structure; record dimensions; perform weld/NDT sample; assemble bogies; torque-mark safety fasteners.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: Carbody kit, bogie kit, wheelsets, brake actuators, weld procedure
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: accepted carbody shell, bogie set, brake subsystem
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: dimensional report, weld pack, NDT report, torque record

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Traction, battery, onboard control, and comms install
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install battery strings, PMSM traction equipment, inverters, brake controllers, onboard SBCs, train comms, firmware identity, and cybersecurity keys.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install harnesses; verify insulation; load signed firmware; bind keys; run static IO and BMS tests.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: Battery modules, inverter kit, T-ECU/SBC kit, signed firmware, key ceremony record
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: powered static trainset with accepted control stack
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: insulation test, BMS report, firmware hash, key-register entry

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Passenger fit-out, doors, HVAC, and static acceptance
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install interiors, doors, HVAC, accessibility equipment, passenger information, CCTV, emergency devices, and complete static acceptance tests.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install fit-out; cycle doors; test HVAC; verify accessibility features; close snags.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: Door kit, HVAC kit, interior kit, passenger systems kit
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: fit-out complete trainset ready for dynamic trial
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: door cycle test, HVAC test, accessibility checklist, snag closeout

manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Run propulsion, braking, doors, onboard control, communications, degraded mode, charging, and trial-running release checks.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Run test scripts; record faults; raise NCRs; re-test; sign release for trial running.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: commissioning script, test track path, charging interface, prior QA evidence
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: trainset released for integrated trial running
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: dynamic test log, fault/NCR closeout, release certificate

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Track section survey, permits, utilities, and access release
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Confirm alignment, utility clashes, drainage path, traffic/access plan, laydown, and safe-work boundary for the section.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Set out control; mark utilities; confirm access; brief crew; upload permits.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: route survey, utility maps, traffic plan, possession plan
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: survey control sheet, utility clearance, permit pack

manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Build formation, drainage, ducts, fence foundations, earthing points, and civil interfaces for track and wayside equipment.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Prepare formation; install drainage; compact layers; inspect ducts; record as-built levels.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: aggregate, geotextile, ducting, drainage materials, fencing materials
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: accepted subgrade and drainage ready for trackform
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: compaction results, level survey, drainage inspection, as-built photos

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Trackform, rail, fasteners, welds, and geometry
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install slab/ballast trackform, rail, fasteners, welds, insulated joints, bonding, and final geometry for the section.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Lay trackform; install rail; weld and grind; measure geometry; close defects.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: rail, fasteners, sleepers/slab materials, weld consumables, bonding kit
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: track section ready for systems installation
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: weld log, geometry report, fastener torque record, bonding test

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Station foundations, platform, canopy, and access structure
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Build platform, foundations, canopy/roof frame, ramps/lifts/escalator allowances, drainage, earthing, and public access civil works.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Set out station; build platform; erect canopy; inspect access routes; record dimensions.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: concrete, steel canopy kit, platform edge kit, drainage and earthing materials
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: station shell ready for MEP and passenger systems
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: structural inspection, access checklist, as-built survey

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Station MEP, passenger systems, fare, and safety fit-out
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install lighting, power, earthing, CCTV, PA/PIS, fare equipment, emergency devices, wayfinding, and local network cabinets.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install MEP; terminate cabinets; configure devices; test passenger systems; close punch list.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: electrical kit, network cabinet, PIS/PA/CCTV kit, fare kit, signage kit
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: MEP test sheet, device register, fare/PIS test, fire/life-safety checklist

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Depot building, production plant, fixtures, and tooling install
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Build depot/plant space, install pits or jacks, lifting equipment, calibration benches, fixtures, storage, and safe production flow.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install fixtures; certify lifting gear; calibrate tools; mark production lanes; release stores.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: depot fit-out kit, fixtures, calibrated tools, lifting equipment, stores racks
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: depot/production plant ready for train and infrastructure work
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: tool calibration certificates, lifting inspection, layout acceptance, safety signoff

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Depot charging, stabling, train wash, and handback systems
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install depot charging, stabling controls, isolation points, train wash allowances, maintenance access, and handback interfaces.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install chargers; prove isolation; test stabling controls; verify depot handback process.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: depot charger kit, switchgear, stabling controls, isolation hardware
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: depot ready for train commissioning and service stabling
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: charger test, isolation test, stabling proof, depot handback checklist

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Waypoint/W-SBC cabinet build and bench test
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Assemble cabinet, SBC, power supply, radio, sensors interface, beacon readers, identity, firmware, and cybersecurity keys.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Build cabinet; load firmware; bind identity; run IO/radio bench test; record serials.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: W-SBC cabinet kit, radio kit, sensor interface, signed firmware, key register
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: serial register, firmware hash, IO test, radio test, key ceremony record

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Waypoint/W-SBC install, coverage, and proof test
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install the waypoint node, connect power/network/sensors, test radio coverage, prove section state messages, and release into integrated trial running.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Mount cabinet; terminate cables; verify coverage; run section-state proof; close cyber checklist.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: bench-accepted cabinet, power feed, comms link, sensor kit, test script
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: commissioned waypoint node ready for trial running
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: coverage map, section-state proof, cyber checklist, commissioning certificate

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Switch kit build, actuator, and bench proof
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Assemble turnout kit, actuator, detection, hand-crank provision, wiring, and bench proof before installation.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Assemble switch; install actuator; bench proof detection; record blade throw and torque.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: turnout kit, actuator, detection sensors, wiring kit
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: bench-accepted switch kit ready for site
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: bench proof record, actuator serial, detection test

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Switch installation, geometry, detection, and route proof
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install switch, prove geometry, detection, hand operation, route locking interface, drainage, and safe return-to-track.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install turnout; align geometry; prove detection; run route proof; upload as-built.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: bench-accepted switch kit, ballast/slab materials, cabling, test script
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: commissioned switch ready for integrated trial
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: geometry report, detection proof, route proof, as-built record

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: PV, BESS, charger, switchgear, and earthing build
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Install PV/BESS/charger equipment, protection, earthing, fire safety, and grid/PPA interface at the site.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Install equipment; terminate protection; test earthing; inspect fire safety; record serials.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: PV kit, BESS kit, charger, switchgear, protection relays, earthing materials
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: earthing test, protection settings, equipment serials, fire-safety inspection

manufacturing_packages.work_order_title: Energy site commissioning and charger proof
manufacturing_packages.work_order_detail: Commission PV, BESS, charger, protection, EMS/SCADA telemetry, load test, and train charging interface.
manufacturing_packages.staff_tasks: Run protection test; commission EMS; load test charger; prove train interface; sign handback.
manufacturing_packages.materials_or_inputs: commissioning test script, SCADA/EMS config, charger interface, train or load bank
manufacturing_packages.deliverables: energy site released for trial running
manufacturing_packages.evidence_required: commissioning report, load test, telemetry proof, handback certificate

maintenance.condition_based_escalation: Amber defects are scheduled within 7 days; red defects hold the asset out of service or isolate the affected railway section until rectified.
maintenance.record_system: Every task produces a signed work order, asset id, date/time, finding code, defect severity, parts used, and return-to-service authority.

manufacturing.planning_basis: Project-day offsets from notice-to-proceed; replace project_day_N with real dates when the city baseline is approved.
manufacturing.work_order_rule: Every manufacturing schedule row can be converted into an Ops Core work order with assignee, due date, evidence, NCR/defect hold, audit, and SQLite persistence.
manufacturing.crew_rule: Crew roles name accountable disciplines, not contractors; local owner-builder teams may staff more than one role.
manufacturing.handover_rule: Closed manufacturing work orders hand over evidence into construction QA, commissioning, and later maintenance records.
manufacturing.reconciliation: SQLite is the source of record when available; browser-local records can be merged through Ops Core reconciliation.
